question_text: How can a late payment affect my credit score?
answer_text: Missing a payment, or paying beyond your due date, can hurt your credit score. As a credit reporter to the Credit Reporting Agencies (CRAs), we are required, per the Fair Credit Reporting Act, to report your pay history accurately. If your payment is more than 30 days beyond your due date, we may report this to the CRAs, meaning the late payment could appear on your credit reports. A CRA generally can report most negative information for seven years. Payment history reported to the CRAs becomes part of your overall credit report. The CRAs use your credit history to develop a credit score. Your credit score is then used by creditors to make decisions surrounding whether to extend you credit. Even one late payment may have negative consequences to your credit score.

question_text: What is Multi-Factor Authentication?
answer_text: TFS uses multi-factor authentication (MFA) to help us verify your identity. MFA is an authentication method used to help prevent unauthorized access to your account by relying on two or more independent factors to verify your identity. With MFA in place, end users are required to supply two or more independent factors to verify your identity.  For example, you may be asked to enter your password and a verification code.  A verification code is a one-time use code that we send to you by email, text or phone call. For additional security, you may choose to receive a verification code each time you login.  You may choose to add this two step verification process when you register your account or anytime from the Profile/Security settings within your account. Although this two step verification process is optional, we may still require a verification code at login in certain instances such as if your risk profile is high, based on your typical login and usage profile and/or you have indicated that you are sharing your device with others.

question_text: What is the 2023 bZ4X?

question_text: Does the home charger come with the vehicle?

In each scenario below the customer will own the charger and is not required to return it. For retail purchase, the charger is treated as an accessory with the associated cost included in the total amount financed. For lease purchase, the charger is treated as an itemized accessory with amount included in the gross capitalized cost. Note : After vehicle sale, the home charging station can be financed with the Toyota Rewards Visa® credit card (see dealer for more details) or through ChargePoint directly for both purchase and installation.

question_text: Does the customer need to purchase a ChargePoint charger?
answer_text: No. There are more than 48,000 public charging stations worldwide. Plus, the bZ4X is equipped standard with the necessary hardware for Level 1 at-home charging. Note : Level 1 charging can be time consuming. Toyota is partnering with ChargePoint for faster at-home Level 2 charging capabilities.

question_text: What do BEV (battery electric vehicle) charger levels mean?
answer_text: There are three levels of charger standards in the industry: Level 1 – Uses standard 120V power commonly available in residential homes. This method can take a day or days to fully charge a BEV. Level 2 – Often referred to as a “charging station” which can be portable but is typically mounted on a wall. This requires installation by a licensed electrician. A BEV can be charged overnight via Level 2. Level 3 – This is a high-power charging which can typically charge a BEV in an hour or less. Level 3 is not viable for residential installation.

question_text: What is the charging power of the charging station?
answer_text: The ChargePoint Home Flex is a Level 2, 240V, 16- to 50-amp flexible amperage home EV charger. Dealers have the option of selling a Level 2 charger directly to customers.

question_text: Are ChargePoint chargers under TFS warranty?

question_text: What is fingerprint authentication?

question_text: What are the benefits of using fingerprint authentication?
answer_text: Quick and convenient to authenticate your identity No typing long passwords on your mobile device No more forgetting or resetting your password Your fingerprint is unique and impossible to guess or replicate Simplifies account recovery

question_text: Is there a fee for using fingerprint authentication?

question_text: Which devices are compatible with fingerprint authentication?

question_text: How do I add a fingerprint to my mobile device?

question_text: Where is my fingerprint stored?
answer_text: Your device stores the information needed to recognize your fingerprint. The myTFS app utilizes the device’s functionality to recognize your fingerprint when you log in. TFS does not store your fingerprint in any way.

question_text: Once I have my fingerprint set up on my mobile device, how do I enable fingerprint authentication from the login page of the myTFS app?

question_text: How do I enable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings?

question_text: How to do I disable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings?

question_text: Can I use different fingerprints to log in?
answer_text: Yes. You can log in using any fingerprint registered on your device.

question_text: Should I use fingerprint authentication if I share my device with others?
answer_text: No. When you log in with Touch ID or Fingerprint enabled, anyone with a registered fingerprint on your device can log into your TFS account. We highly recommend you do not enable Touch ID or Fingerprint if you share your device.

question_text: What should I do if my device is lost or stolen?

answer_text: If a change to the fingerprint registry is detected on your device, fingerprint authentication will be disabled. You will have to add a new fingerprint to reactivate fingerprint authentication on your device.

question_text: How do I enable additional security from Security Settings?

question_text: How do I disable additional security?
answer_text: Follow these steps to disable additional security from Security Settings: Log in to the myTFS app Select "More" from the Home/My Account page Select "Security" Toggle switch On or Off to have their security question presented during fingerprint authentication login Receive a confirmation pop-up Select "Confirm" to disable fingerprint authentication two-step verification

question_text: What do I do if my vehicle is in an accident?
answer_text: Whenever you are in an automobile accident, we suggest you contact your insurance company as soon as possible. We recommend your insurance company contact our Customer Service Team toll-free at 1-800-874-8822 between the hours of 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m., Monday - Friday, local time. Please note that you are still responsible for your monthly payments until the claim is settled with your insurance company, and the account is satisfied.

question_text: I got a check from my insurance company made out to TFS and me. What should I do with it?
answer_text: Normally, an insurance check to repair physical damage is made out to both you and Toyota Financial Services to ensure that the vehicle gets repaired. Please mail the insurance check for endorsement to the following address: Toyota Financial Services P.O. Box 22171 Tempe, AZ 85285 Please include your account number on any documentation that you send in to ensure we are able to access your account. Note: For insurance checks in excess of $7,500.00, please include a copy of the completed repair order along with the check for endorsement.

question_text: What are the insurance requirements for a financed or leased vehicle?
answer_text: Insurance requirements will vary based on the state where you live. Purchase: If you financed your vehicle, TFS requires you to maintain physical damage insurance covering loss or damage for the full value of the vehicle for the term of your contract. There are no deductible limitations. We do not have minimum liability requirements for financed vehicles. Lease: If you leased your vehicle, TFS will accept the minimum liability required by the state in which your leased vehicle is garaged. Physical damage insurance is required for the full value of the vehicle, with a maximum deductible of $1,000.

question_text: What address should I give to my insurance company?
answer_text: Please provide the following address to your insurance company: TMCC P.O. Box 105386 Atlanta, GA 30348 You are required to keep insurance on your vehicle during the term of the contract, but you are not required to forward us a copy of your insurance policy.

question_text: What are my lease-end options?
answer_text: As your lease comes to an end, your options generally fall into three categories: Replacing your current vehicle by either leasing or purchasing a new Toyota Purchasing your current vehicle either outright or by financing your payoff amount Returning your vehicle Your original dealership is obligated to accept your return, though you are not required to return the vehicle to your original dealership if you have moved or prefer a different dealer. If you prefer to go with a different dealership, it is advisable to contact them in advance to confirm that they’ll accept your lease return. Click here to explore your Toyota lease-end options and see any exclusive loyalty offers for which you may be eligible. If you’re unsure of your lease maturity date, check your lease-end dashboard, here .

question_text: How will TFS contact me before my lease ends?
answer_text: Leading up to lease-end, you’ll receive various communications from TFS about your options and things you need to do. Be on the lookout for information from us through toyotafinancial.com, your billing statement, email and/or phone calls.

question_text: What is my lease maturity date?
answer_text: The lease maturity date is the date on which your lease ends and your vehicle must be returned. Alternatively, you can also purchase your leased vehicle or replace it with a new lease. To see when your lease will reach maturity, click here .

question_text: Where do I turn in my leased vehicle?
answer_text: Your leased vehicle should be turned in at your originating Toyota dealer by your scheduled lease maturity date. If you've moved since you began your lease, use our easy dealer locator to find a participating dealer near you. We recommend contacting the dealer to schedule your lease turn-in appointment approximately 30 days prior to your lease maturity date.

question_text: Can I return my leased vehicle to any dealer?
answer_text: The vehicle must be returned to an authorized Toyota or Lexus Dealer. We recommend contacting your originating Dealer to schedule your turn-in appointment. Most Toyota and Lexus Dealers will process a vehicle return even if they did not originate the lease, but we recommend contacting them to confirm and schedule a turn-in appointment. Your originating Dealer is required to process the vehicle return. If you return the vehicle to a third-party dealership, this is an unauthorized third-party vehicle return and you remain responsible for all obligations under the lease agreement until we receive the payoff funds and all required documentation, or the vehicle is delivered to a Toyota or Lexus Dealer.

question_text: Who is my originating dealer?
answer_text: Your originating dealer is the dealer where you began your lease. This dealer can help you choose your next Toyota and turn in your current leased vehicle.

question_text: What should I bring to my turn-in appointment?
answer_text: Bring your clean, leased vehicle along with: Your TFS Odometer Disclosure Statement Tool kit and spare tire, if applicable All sets of keys (masters/remotes/valet), if applicable Owner’s Manuals Any original equipment on your vehicle at lease inception (radio, headrests, 3rd row seat, tonneau/cargo cover, etc.) As a heads up, if you don’t return the original equipment or keys at the end of your lease, you may receive additional charges based on the terms of your lease agreement.

question_text: Should I notify Toyota Financial Services after I have returned my leased vehicle?
answer_text: Yes, to minimize any potential delays processing your lease return, you can notify us of your return by logging on to Toyotafinancial.com or your Toyota Financial Services App and follow the Lease-End return prompts. You can also notify us by telephone at (800) 874-8822 using our automated system or speaking with a live agent. Click here to log in to your account.

question_text: What if I turn in my vehicle early?
answer_text: You may return your vehicle prior to your lease maturity date; however, early termination fees may apply. For more info about turning in your lease early, refer to your lease agreement, or contact TFS at 1-800-286-0652 . You may also reach out to your dealer to get answers to any questions you have about your options.

question_text: Should I schedule an appointment to return my vehicle to my Toyota dealer?
answer_text: Yes, just give your dealer a call 30 days prior to your lease maturity date to schedule your lease turn-in appointment.

question_text: What charges should I expect on my End of Term Invoice after I turn in my vehicle?
answer_text: Like you, we hope you have no charges on your lease-end, but it’s possible these may be included, if applicable: 1 Excess wear and use Excess mileage Disposition fee Any past due and unpaid monthly payments Any other miscellaneous charges (e.g., unpaid late payment fees, taxes, tolls) Any other charges due under the terms of your lease agreement if your lease was terminated early

question_text: Do I return my license plates when I turn in my vehicle?
answer_text: Great question – it varies by state. Please contact your Toyota dealer or the DMV if you have questions about how this applies to you.

question_text: How do I purchase my current vehicle?
answer_text: Great decision! You will need to get a payoff quote by logging in to your TFS online account. Follow these steps to see your End Of Lease Options: Log in to the website Select "Menu" from the top navigation bar Select “End Of Lease Options” under Manage Account Select “Purchase Your Vehicle” Select “Confirm” to validate your address See options to purchase If you need financing, you can head straight to your dealer for help or select “Contact Your Dealer”

question_text: What’s the easiest way to get into a new Toyota?
answer_text: Just bring your vehicle back to your Toyota dealer at the end of your lease and they can help you with the rest.

question_text: Why was my recurring payment cancelled?
answer_text: If your final lease payment has been made, we will automatically cancel recurring payments.

question_text: Where can I find payoff information for loan account?
answer_text: Log into the website or mobile app From the dashboard, select “Payoff Quote” under Remaining Balance You can then submit your payoff payment online or send the payment via mail. A Payoff Quote is good for 10 days from the date it is provided. * After that time, you can log in to the website or mobile app and view an updated Payoff Quote. *Note: While a Payoff Quote is good for 10 days, the amount is subject to change if additional amounts, such as, but not limited to, returned payments or other charges or fees post to the account after we provide the Payoff Quote.

question_text: How can I send the payoff funds for my loan account?
answer_text: 1. Website or Mobile App Register or Log in to the website and select “Payoff Quote” from the dashboard to view your payoff amount. Select “Payoff” button to make your payment. 2. Mail Toyota Financial Services P.O. Box 94305 Palatine, IL 60094-4305 3. Mail (for overnighted funds) Toyota Financial Services Attn: Retail Payoff Box 94305 5503 N. Cumberland Ave., Suite 307 Chicago, IL 60656

question_text: Once my loan is paid off, how long will it take to receive my vehicle title/lien release?
answer_text: The expected delivery date will depend on your title type. To locate your title type, log into the website or mobile app and from the Dashboard select Title/Lien Release Status.  Then select “Title Information” to view your title type. Paper Titles/Lien Releases: expect to receive it within 25-40 business days (from the date the payoff is posted to the account – this includes mail time) Generally, we'll send the title/lien release to you or an authorized recipient, within 10 business days after the payoff is posted to your account, depending on payment method and applicable state law. Allow 15-30 business days for United States Postal Service delivery. Electronic Titles: expect to receive the paper title from the state within 7.5-9.5 weeks (from the date the payoff is posted to the account – this includes mail and state agency processing time.) Generally, we’ll notify the state of the lien release within 10 business days after the payoff is posted to your account, depending on payment method and applicable state law. Allow 6-8 weeks for the state to provide you with your title. Exception: Florida and Arizona generally require the title to remain electronic unless the owner requests a paper title. For additional questions, please contact your state titling agency.

question_text: Where will the title/lien release be sent?
answer_text: Paper Title/Lien Release We’ll mail the title/lien release to your primary address on file, unless instructed otherwise.  Your primary address is either the garage address for the vehicle or your mailing address, if you provided a separate address to receive TFS correspondence. Electronic Title We’ll notify the state of the lien release, and they’ll typically mail the title to the registered owner’s address unless instructed otherwise. Exception: Florida and Arizona generally require the title to remain electronic unless the owner requests a paper title). If you’d like the title/lien release to be sent to a third party: Written or verbal authorization is required for the title/lien release to be sent to a third party (e.g., dealer, insurance company, another financial institution or individual third party). Please include your written authorization with mailed payoff funds or contact us at (800) 874-8822.

question_text: How can I update my title/lien release delivery address?
answer_text: If payoff funds are sent via mail, you may include written instructions with the payoff funds. After you have paid off, if you need to update the delivery address, please contact us at (800) 874-8822. Written or verbal authorization is required for the title/lien release to be sent to a third party (e.g., dealer, insurance company, another financial institution or individual third party).  Please include your written authorization with the mailed payoff funds or contact us at (800) 874-8822.

question_text: What should I do if I paid off my loan but have not received my title/lien release?
answer_text: Your next steps will vary based on your title type. To locate your title type, log into Toyota Financial Services website or mobile app and from the Dashboard select Title/Lien Release Status.  Select “Title Information” to view to your title type. Paper Title/Lien Release If it has been more than 40 business days since your payoff was posted, please contact us at (800) 874-8822. Electronic Title If it has been more than 9.5 weeks since your payoff was posted, contact your local state titling agency.

question_text: What is the difference between Pay Online and the AutoCheque program?
answer_text: Pay Online is a flexible and convenient electronic payment method that allows you to schedule, view, update, or cancel payments, and check the payment processing status on our website. Customers can also schedule one-time payments and set up Recurring Payment Profiles. You enrolled in Pay Online when you registered on to the website. To make payments or view website payment details, you need to add a bank account. The AutoCheque program offers the convenience of automatically debiting your bank each month. To get started, download the AutoCheque Enrollment Authorization Form and follow the instructions in the form (Note: To access this form, you need to install the free Adobe Acrobat Reader DC onto your computer). After receiving your completed and signed form, we will process your enrollment request. Enrollment is generally completed within 14 business days.

question_text: How do I set up a one-time or recurring payment?
answer_text: Follow these steps to make a One-Time or Recurring Payment: Log in to the website Select "Set Up Recurring Payments" or “Make One-Time Payment” from your Dashboard Fill in the required fields to schedule your payment Select "Confirm" on the Payment page

question_text: What is an ABA routing number?
answer_text: An ABA routing number (also known as a "Routing Transit" number) is an identification number, assigned to a financial institution and each branch office of that financial institution, which speeds up the processing of transfers between financial institutions.

question_text: If I have multiple account holders in my family, can we each enroll in Pay Online?
answer_text: Yes. Each account holder may set up a "Recurring Payments Profile" or make one-time payments. However, one account holder will not be able to view or use the other account holder’s banking information. In addition, each account holder can manage only the payments he or she has set up.

question_text: Why can't I select some of the dates on the calendar when I am scheduling a payment?
answer_text: There are several limits to the dates you can schedule for payments: Recurring payments cannot be scheduled for the 29th, 30th, or 31st of the month. One-time payments cannot be scheduled for weekends, bank holidays, or further than 60 days in advance. Note: A payment scheduled before 5:00 p.m. PST will be credited to your account that same day.

question_text: Can I make more than one payment in a month?
answer_text: You can schedule as many one-time payments as you'd like, as often as you'd like.

question_text: When does my same-day payment update to pending status?
answer_text: Your same-day payment changes to “Pending” at 5:00 p.m. PST. Once your payment changes to “Pending” status, you will not be able to change the payment information.

question_text: How do I remove a bank account and what will happen if I do?
answer_text: Follow these steps to remove a bank account: Log in to the website Select “Menu” from the top navigation bar Select “Manage Bank Accounts” under Payments Select “Delete” next to the applicable bank account A “Delete Bank” window will pop up Click the “Delete” button The bank account information will be removed from the “Manage Bank Accounts” page Any scheduled recurring payments or one-time payments linked to your removed bank account will be canceled. To continue to use Pay Online, you must add another bank account.

question_text: What happens if my bank rejects a payment?
answer_text: Payments may be returned by a financial institution for insufficient funds, closed accounts or other reasons. If a payment is returned, we may discontinue your participation in the Pay Online program. If this occurs, all scheduled payments, except those in “Pending” status, will be cancelled. If your bank rejects a payment, you are still obligated to make your payment on time and in the specified amount.

question_text: How do I delete or cancel a payment and what if I am unable to?
answer_text: Follow these steps to delete or cancel a website payment: Log in to the website Scroll down to Transactions and select “View All Transactions” Select the “+” under Details Select “Cancel Payment” Unfortunately, once your payment status changes to "Processing," you are no longer able to edit or cancel it. If there are multiple account holders on one account, you may only edit or cancel a payment you have set up. You can also stop payment by contacting your financial institution.

question_text: How do I cancel pay online?
answer_text: You were automatically enrolled in Pay Online when you registered for an account the website. You can delete a “Recurring Payments Profile,” cancel scheduled payments, or delete your bank account information.* Follow these steps to delete your “Recurring Payments Profile”: Log in to your account Select “Payments” from the top navigation bar Click through to the “Website Payments” page From the “Recurring Payments Profiles” section, select “Delete” A “Delete Recurring Profile” window will pop up Click the “Delete Profile” button Your “Recurring Payments Profile” will be removed from the “Website Payments” page Follow these steps to cancel scheduled payments: Log in to your account Select “Payments” from the top navigation bar Click through to the “Website Payments” page Locate the scheduled payment, select “Cancel” Select “Cancel Payment” The payment status will change from “Scheduled” to “Cancelled” Follow these steps to delete your bank account information: Log in to your account Select “Payments” from the top navigation bar Click through to the “Bank Information” page Select “Delete” next to the applicable bank account A “Delete Bank” window will pop up Click the “Delete Bank Account” button The bank account information will be removed from the “Bank Information” page Note: All payments linked to the bank account information that are in “Scheduled” status will be cancelled. * If there are multiple account holders on one account, you will not be unable to make changes to the other account holder’s “Recurring Payments Profile,” edit scheduled payments, or remove bank account information.

question_text: What types of payment notifications will I receive?
answer_text: You will automatically receive payment confirmations, reminders, and general account updates to your email address on file.

question_text: How do I change my email address?
answer_text: Follow these steps to change your email address: Log in to the website Select “My Profile” under the Welcome Tab Select “Login & Security” Select the pen icon under Two-Factor Authentication Update Email You will receive a verification code to confirm your changes

question_text: How can I print pages from Pay Online?
answer_text: Click the “Print Page” icon to print the “Payment Confirmation” and “Website Payments” pages. When the “Print Page” icon is not present, use the print feature of your browser or simply press the “Ctrl” and “P” keys simultaneously on your keyboard to print.

question_text: What are marketing preferences? Are they different from notifications?
answer_text: Marketing preferences give you a chance to pick the channel where you'd prefer to receive marketing communications, which can include product news and information, updates on model launches, and invitations to exclusive events from TFS. Marketing preferences differ from notifications, which include messages about statements and payments.

question_text: How do I select marketing preferences and what channels are available?
answer_text: Follow these steps to select your Marketing Preferences: Log in to the website Select “My Profile” under the Welcome Tab Select “Communication Preferences” Choose how and whether to receive marketing reminders You will see a message confirming that your communication preferences have been updated.

question_text: Where can I find my mileage allowance?
answer_text: The easiest way to find your mileage allowance is by looking at your lease agreement. If you can’t find your lease agreement – no worries – your friends at your local dealer will be happy to help you find it.

question_text: What if I go over my mileage allowance?
answer_text: No problem, it happens. If you return your vehicle and it has gone over the mileage allowance, you will be charged for the additional mileage. We recommend calling your dealer to learn more about additional mileage charges so you can plan ahead.

question_text: Can I get additional miles?
answer_text: We wish there was a way to purchase additional miles. Unfortunately, we’re not currently offering that as an option.

question_text: How can I see the mileage allowance in my lease agreement and track progress?
answer_text: Follow these steps to access your Mileage Calculator: Log in to your account Select “Menu” from the top navigation bar Select “Mileage Calculator” under Manage Account

question_text: Where can I get information on the Toyota rebate program for military members?
answer_text: Please visit our Military Rebate page for more information. We thank you for your service.

question_text: Am I eligible for benefits under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA)? Who do I contact with to activate my benefits?
answer_text: Generally, the provisions of the SCRA apply to active duty military personnel: Army Navy Marine Corps Air Force Coast Guard Public Health Officers detailed to the Army or Navy on active duty Military reservists and guardsmen called to active duty SCRA benefits vary. For example, some benefits only apply to servicemembers who enter into a lease or finance obligation prior to being called to active duty. SCRA benefits may also extend to the spouses and dependents of active duty military personnel. To find out if you are eligible for benefits under the SCRA, contact the United States Armed Forces Legal Assistance office closest to you.

question_text: What documentation will I need to provide to Toyota Financial Services to receive SCRA benefits?
answer_text: Please contact our Customer Service Team to ensure that you understand all documentation you need to submit to receive SCRA benefits.

question_text: Where can I find the payment allotment code for my branch of the military?
answer_text: Here are some payment allotment code details, per military branch: Branch of Military Retail Blanket Code Lease Blanket Code Army X069255 X069263 Navy S938513 S951672 Air Force S938513 S951672 Marines 0174 0169 Retired L93 L57

question_text: I am in the military or employed by the United States government. How can I take my vehicle with me if I leave the U.S.?
answer_text: You'll need a letter of consent from TFS to move your vehicle from the U.S. Please contact our Customer Service Team for the most current requirements.

question_text: How do I download the Toyota Financial Services mobile app?
answer_text: The mobile app is available for download through the Apple App Store and Google Play . Note: As we enhance the app, we will periodically release updates. Please refer to your application notifications either from iTunes or Google updates.

question_text: Are there fees to use the mobile app?
answer_text: There is no charge to download or use the mobile app. However, you should contact your wireless service provider to see if any connectivity or usage rates may apply.

question_text: I made a payment from the mobile app
answer_text: You may follow the progress of your payment in the Account History page of the website. Your mobile app payment will be displayed in the Scheduled Payments section when the payment status is "scheduled" or "approved". Once the payment is applied to your account, your recent transactions will also be visible in the Account History page.

question_text: What security measures help protect my transactions through the mobile app?
answer_text: Our 128-bit SSL encryption technology safeguards traffic for secure web applications and helps protects your information as it travels from your mobile device to us.

question_text: How can I be sure the mobile app information is secure if my mobile device is lost or stolen?
answer_text: You are required to enter a valid Username and Password to access your account information from the mobile app.  If your mobile device is lost or stolen, no one can access your account without your login credentials.

question_text: What is fingerprint authentication?
answer_text: Fingerprint authentication lets you log in to the myTFS app with your fingerprint in place of your username and password. ● Touch ID is fingerprint authentication technology for Apple mobile devices. ● Fingerprint is fingerprint authentication technology for Android mobile devices.

question_text: What are the benefits of using fingerprint authentication?
answer_text: ● Quick and convenient to authenticate your identity ● No typing long passwords on your mobile device ● No more forgetting or resetting your password ● Your fingerprint is unique and impossible to guess or replicate ● Simplifies account recovery

question_text: Is there fee for using fingerprint authentication?
answer_text: No. Fingerprint authentication is free to TFS account holders with mobile devices.

question_text: Which devices are compatible with fingerprint authentication?
answer_text: ●For Touch ID, Apple mobile device with iOS 6.0 or higher with Touch ID functionality ●For Fingerprint, Android mobile device with OS 7.0 or higher with Fingerprint functionality

question_text: How do I add a fingerprint to my mobile device?
answer_text: Visit your device settings and select Touch ID & Settings (from an Apple mobile device) or Lock Screen and Security (from an Android mobile device). From there, follow the steps to register one or more fingerprints on your device.

question_text: Where is my fingerprint stored?
answer_text: Your device stores the information needed to recognize your fingerprint. The myTFS app utilizes the device's functionality to recognize your fingerprint when you log in. TFS does not store your fingerprint in any way.

question_text: What account features are available on the mobile app?
answer_text: You are able to do the following: ✓ Make a payment ✓ View & edit app payments ✓ View payoff & contract information ✓ View Account History ✓ Retrieve contact information

question_text: Once I have my fingerprint set up on my mobile device, how do I enable fingerprint authentication from the login page of the myTFS app?
answer_text: Follow these steps to enable Fingerprint authentication in the myTFS app: a.Enter your username, password and select the box next to Enable Touch ID or Enable Fingerprint b.Select Login c.Enter the Answer to the Security Question, if applicable d. Agree to the Electronic Communications & Agreements and Mobile Application Polices and Agreements e.Select Enable to activate fingerprint authentication f.Update your Security Question and Answer g.Select if you would like the Security Question to be presented with every login h.Select Finish to complete enrollment

question_text: How do I enable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings?
answer_text: Follow these steps to enable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings: a. Log in to the myTFS app with your username and password b.Select More from the Home / My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle the Touch ID or Fingerprint switch On e.Select Continue to go to the Login page f.Enter your username, password and select the box next to Enable Touch ID or Enable Fingerprint g.Select Login h.Enter the Answer to the Security Question i.Select if the device is Personal or Shared, then select Continue j. Agree to the Electronic Communications & Agreements and Mobile Application Policies and Agreements k.Select Enable to activate Fingerprint authentication l.Select OK to set up your Security Question and Answer for Fingerprint authentication m.Select a new Security Question n.Enter the Answer to the Security Question, thenselect Continue o.Select if you would like the Security Question to be presented with every login p.Select Finish to complete enrollment

question_text: How to do I disable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings?
answer_text: Follow these steps to disable fingerprint authentication from Security Settings: a.Log in to the myTFS app b.Select More from the Home / My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle the Touch ID or Fingerprint switch Off e.Confirmation pop up is presented f.Select Continue to turn disable fingerprint authentication

question_text: Once fingerprint authentication is enabled and set up on the myTFS app, how do I log in to my TFS account using fingerprint authentication?
answer_text: Follow these steps to log in to your TFS account using fingerprint authentication: a.Open the myTFS app b. You will be prompted to scan your fingerprint to log in by placing your finger on the device touchpad ( Home button) c.If challenged with a Security Question, enter the Answer d.Select Continue to complete login

question_text: Can I use different fingerprints to log in?
answer_text: Yes. You can log in using any fingerprint registered on your device.

question_text: Should I use fingerprint authentication if I share my device with others?
answer_text: No. When you log in with Touch ID or Fingerprint enabled, anyone with a registered fingerprint on your device can log into your TFS account. We highly recommend you do not enable Touch ID or Fingerprint if you share your device.

question_text: What should I do if my device is lost or stolen?
answer_text: You should contact your mobile carrier first, then contact our Customer Service Center and let us know that you device has been lost or stolen. We can disable the login feature within the fingerprint authentication feature on the myTFS app. If you have the Find My iPhone app on your Apple mobile device, or the Find My Device app on your Android mobile device, you can lock your device and keep your information safe. Contact Apple or Google for more information.

question_text: Once I have enrolled in Touch ID or Fingerprint, can I still log in to my account with my username and password?
answer_text: Yes. You can log in to your account with your username and password any time. When you open the myTFS app and prompted to scan your fingerprint, select Cancel to return to the Login page where you can enter your username and password.

question_text: What happens if I change a fingerprint stored on my phone?
answer_text: If a change to the fingerprint registry is detected on your device, fingerprint authentication will be disabled.  You will have to add a new fingerprint to reactivate fingerprint authentication on your device.

question_text: How do I enable additional security from Security Settings?
answer_text: Follow these steps to enable additional security from Security Settings on your mobile device: a. Log in to the myTFS app b.Select More from the Home/My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle switch On or Off to have your security question presented every time you login e.Select a Security Question f.Enter the Answer to the Security Question g.Select Continue h.Receive a confirmation pop-up i.Select OK

question_text: How do I start using the mobile app?
answer_text: If you have registered for account access from our website, use your login credentials to use the app.  If you have not yet registered on the website, launch the app and select Register from the opening screen.

question_text: How do I disable additional security?
answer_text: Follow these steps to disable additional security from Security Settings: a.Log in to the myTFS app b.Select More from the Home/My Account page c.Select Security d.Toggle switch On or Off to have their security question presented during Fingerprint authentication login e.Receive a confirmation pop-up f.Select Confirm to disable fingerprint authentication two-step verification

question_text: How can I make a principal-only payment on the Mobile App?
answer_text: Follow these steps to make a principal-only payment via the Mobile App: Log in to the app Select “Make A Payment” on the Dashboard Select “Make A Principal Only Payment” Select the Amount and click Continue Select “Pay On” date and confirm Bank Account Swipe to Confirm

question_text: Do I have to be registered from your website to use the mobile app?
answer_text: No. You can register on the app. To use the app, you will be required to accept the Online Policies & Agreements for Mobile Device Applications.

question_text: Will I be able to access my account from the mobile app without username and password?
answer_text: No. To help protect your data, we require customers to enter a valid Username and Password to access the secure account section.

question_text: Will my Username and Password from your website work on the mobile app?
answer_text: Yes. You will be able to access your account from the app using the same login credentials from our website. To use the app, you will be required to accept the Online Policies & Agreements for Mobile Device Applications.

question_text: If I registered from the mobile app, will the login credentials work on your website?
answer_text: Yes, The login credentials can be used from either the mobile app or website.  If you registered from the app and login for the first time to our website, you will be required to accept the Online Policies & Agreements for website.

question_text: After how many incorrect login attempts will the mobile app be locked?
answer_text: After your fifth invalid login attempt, your access to the mobile app will be locked. From the login screen, use the self-service tools such as "Forgot Password" and "Forgot Username" to reset your login credentials.

question_text: Will my session time out while using the mobile app?
answer_text: Yes. To help protect your data, the mobile app session will time out after 5 minutes. To avoid time out, ensure you are active in the session after you login.

question_text: If I apply for credit, am I obligated to finance or lease a vehicle through TFS?
answer_text: No, the online credit application is a tool to help you shop for your vehicle and creates no obligation to finance or lease a vehicle from TFS or from the dealer you select during the process.

question_text: Do I have to go to the dealer on my online credit application?
answer_text: No. If you are pre-approved for a finance or lease contract, you will receive a pre-approval certificate (via email) that you can use at any participating Toyota dealer. If you use this certificate at a dealer other than the one listed on your online credit application, you are applying for credit at that dealership and may need to provide additional information.

question_text: How secure is the online credit form?
answer_text: As a financial services company, TFS works hard to protect your privacy and security. We have adopted technology and security standards widely used throughout the online banking industry. When you submit your credit application or access your account information, your data is encrypted for further security. Please read our Privacy Policy for more information.

question_text: I'm not comfortable applying for credit online. Are there other ways I can apply?
answer_text: Yes. If you would rather not apply online, simply download the application , fill it out, then fax or take a hard copy with you to your local Toyota dealer. Note : To view and print this PDF document, you need to install the free Adobe Acrobat Reader DC on to your computer.

question_text: Why can't I use the online credit application?
answer_text: If you entered your ZIP code and got a message that you were out of our serviced area, that means that the dealers in your area don't take online applications. Instead, you can simply print out the application form , fill it out and take a hard copy in to your local dealer.

question_text: Will a credit check be run on my co-applicant?
answer_text: Yes. Since your co-applicant is applying to be the co-buyer or lessee on your finance or lease contract, we need to run a credit report for you and your co-applicant.

question_text: Why do you need my zip code? Can I change it after submitting my application?
answer_text: We ask for your ZIP code to determine if you are in an area where the local dealers accept online credit applications. Because vehicle option combinations vary by region, your ZIP code also helps us more accurately estimate the amount you'll need to finance or lease a vehicle in your area. We remember your ZIP code to help create a personalized experience, allowing us to provide accurate information for your area of residence. The ZIP code you enter as part of the online credit application process is an example of this. To change to a different ZIP code, you'll need to close and re-launch your Internet browser to begin a new session.

question_text: Why does the form repeatedly return me to the zip code entry screen?
answer_text: Your browser settings need to accept "cookies" for all of the features of the online credit application to work correctly. Cookies allow us to receive and store information when your browser accesses our website. If your browser settings are not set to accept cookies, you will not be able to complete the online credit application process. If you'd like to enable cookies within your browser, refer to the "Help" portion of your browser's toolbar.

question_text: What happens if I leave my computer in the middle of the application process?
answer_text: If you leave your computer for 5 minutes or more, your credit application session will time out. This security feature has been put in place to protect your personal information. Please note that if your session times out, the information you entered will be erased and you'll need to begin the process again.

question_text: The website and application list a Total SRP. How is the final sales price determined?
answer_text: Total SRP is the Total Suggested Retail Price from the manufacturer. The final price will be agreed upon by you and the dealer.

question_text: How is my annual percentage rate (APR) determined?
answer_text: Your Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is agreed upon by you and your dealer. Take a look at Understanding The Finance Charges to see how your interest is calculated. Note: To view this PDF document, you need to install the free Adobe Acrobat Reader DC on to your computer.

question_text: What happens after my application is received?
answer_text: After you submit your application, our credit analysts review it and make a decision. If you are approved, we notify you via email within one business day. The email has a pre-approval certificate embedded in it that is valid for 30 days from the date it was issued. You can use it at the Toyota dealer of your choice or at any participating Toyota dealer. Your selected dealer may also contact you to schedule an appointment to discuss your financing needs. In some cases, TFS and your dealer may need more time to finalize a credit decision. If you are not approved within one business day, your dealer may contact you with details on the status of your application. You should receive a final credit decision from us within three business days.

question_text: What are my options if my application is not approved?
answer_text: You can contact your selected dealer (or any participating dealer) for more information and your options. You will also receive a letter from TFS explaining our credit decision and your rights.

question_text: I was approved with modified terms. How do I find out what the original terms were?
answer_text: You can contact your selected dealer (or any participating dealer) to discuss the details of your original terms and your modified approval.

question_text: Where can I find my pre-approval certificate?
answer_text: The pre-approval certificate is embedded in the body of the approval email, instead of being sent as a separate attachment. Print and take the email with you to your dealer. If you applied with a co-applicant, only the primary applicant will receive a pre-approval certificate.

question_text: What is Paperless?
answer_text: Paperless is a free service that replaces your paper billing statements with electronic paperless billing statements. You receive email alerts when your statements are available to view online, approximately 2 weeks before your monthly payment due date.

question_text: How do I enroll in Paperless Billing?
answer_text: When you register your account online, you are automatically enrolled in paperless billing statements. If you are receiving paper billing statements and would like to enroll in paperless billing, follow these steps: Log in to the website Select “Menu” from the top navigation bar Select “Billing Statements” under Manage Account Toggle the “Go Paperless” button to On Select "Go Paperless" on the enable paperless billing pop-up

question_text: I just enrolled in Go Paperless. When will my first paperless billing statement be available to view online?
answer_text: You will receive an email notification stating that your billing statement is available to view online approximately 2 weeks before your monthly payment due date. However, if you are a new customer, it may take up to 2 billing cycles to activate. Note: Please continue to make payments with your paper statement until you receive an email notification that you can view and access your statements online.

question_text: How do I cancel Paperless?
answer_text: Follow these steps to cancel Paperless and receive your billing statements in paper form: Log in to the website Select “Menu” from the top navigation bar Select “Billing Statements” under Manage Account Toggle the “Go Paperless” button to Off Select "Disable Paperless" on the pop-up All statements will remain available online. Note : If we've posted a paperless statement to your account prior to your Paperless cancellation, a paper statement (for your current payment) will not be mailed to you. You are still required to send in your payment by the due date. After we have processed your Paperless cancellation, paper statements will be mailed to you.

question_text: What if I cancel Paperless, then change my mind?
answer_text: You can change your Toyota Financial account’s Paperless settings, including enrolling, un-enrolling, or re-enrolling in Paperless, by changing the settings in your “My Profile” section. Click here to access your profile settings , then click on “Communication Preferences” at the top and make your selections.

question_text: What are my privacy choices? How do I set up preferences to allow or limit how TFS shares my personal information?
answer_text: Privacy Choices allow you to limit the way TFS shares and uses your personal information. Follow these steps to set up your preferences: Log in to the website Select “My Profile” from under the Welcome Tab Click “Privacy Choices” Select the item(s) you wish to allow sharing Click the “Save Changes” button, and you will receive a message informing you that your privacy choices have been updated

question_text: What are my options for receiving my Privacy Policy and will I need to update my choice each year? After I have made a choice, can I change it later?
answer_text: We provide you with the most up-to-date version of your Privacy Policy on an annual basis either by mail or electronically. On the TFS website, you can choose how you'd like to receive your Privacy Policy. You won't need to update your choice each year, it will remain in effect until it is changed or revoked by you. You can change your choice on the TFS website at any time. However, please be aware that choices made within a short time period prior to the annual mailing may not go into effect at the time of mailing. We will post on the TFS website the final day that changes may be made, which will affect your current annual mailings.

question_text: What happens if I don't make a choice?
answer_text: If no choice is made, you will receive your Privacy Policy by mail. Additionally, you'll be able to view your Privacy Policy on the TFS website at any time as long as you are a registered user. If you choose to receive your Privacy Policy only electronically, you will no longer receive a copy in the mail and will get an email notification informing you that a new Privacy Policy is ready to view on the TFS website. Note: California customers will receive an email with the Privacy Policy as an attachment.

question_text: Will I be able to view the most recent version of the Privacy Policy on the TFS website?
answer_text: Yes. All customers who are registered on the TFS website can view their most recent Privacy Policy online. If you choose to receive the Privacy Policy only electronically, we will no longer mail you a copy.

question_text: If I already opted in for paperless billing, does that mean I will also receive my Privacy Policy electronically?
answer_text: No. Opting in for paperless billing does not apply to the Privacy Policy. You need to take an additional step to choose to receive your Privacy Policy only electronically.

question_text: Why are there other documents listed along with the Privacy Policy that I can choose to receive only electronically? Can I choose to receive some documents electronically and others by paper?
answer_text: On an annual basis, TFS provides you with your Privacy Policy, a Legal & Servicing Notice, and our Pay by Phone Error Resolution Notice. For each document type listed, you can choose how they are received. You may choose to receive all of them electronically, by mail, or a combination of both.

question_text: Will I be charged a fee if I chose to receive my privacy policy only electronically?
answer_text: No. There is no fee associated your preference for how you wish to receive your Privacy Policy or any other TFS account-related document.

question_text: Is the distribution of the Privacy Policy the only instance in which I will receive my Privacy Policy electronically?
answer_text: No. If you move from one state to another and notify us with your new address, you may receive a new Privacy Policy due to state-specific content.

question_text: If I chose to receive my Privacy Policy only electronically, why am I still receiving a paper notice at my mailing address?
answer_text: If you chose to receive your Privacy Policy only electronically, but the email we send to notify you is unable to be delivered, we will mail it to ensure that you receive a copy. Also, in some cases involving multiple account holders, if one chooses to receive their notice electronically, while others do not, a notice may be mailed.

question_text: Are there any incentives for repeat customers?
answer_text: If you've previously financed or leased a vehicle through TFS, you may be eligible for special benefits, including a disposition fee waiver. Contact your dealer or visit our repeat customer page to learn more.

question_text: How can I get brochures for the programs or vehicles I am interested in?
answer_text: To download Toyota vehicle brochures, please visit the Get a Toyota Brochure page on Toyota.com. Note: To view the PDF documents, you need to install the free Adobe Acrobat Reader DC on to your computer.

question_text: I'm shopping for a used Toyota and keep coming across the term "TCUV." What does that mean?
answer_text: "TCUV" stands for Toyota Certified Used Vehicle. TCUVs are different from other used Toyota vehicles because each one undergoes a 160-point comprehensive Quality Assurance Inspection, receives a Vehicle History Report, and includes a 12-month/12,000-mile Comprehensive Warranty,* a 7-year/100,000-mile Limited Powertrain Warranty, and 1 year of 24/7 Roadside Assistance.** To learn more, check out our Toyota Financial Services TCUV Program and visit Toyotacertified.com . * Whichever comes first, from date of Toyota Certified Used Vehicle purchase ** Whichever comes first, from original date of first use when sold as new

question_text: What is Support Center and is it secure?
answer_text: Support Center gives you a secure way to reach our Customer Service Team. It works like a personal inbox on the TFS website, with the added security that your Support Requests can only be viewed by you and us. 1 To utlize the Support Center, log in to your account and go to the Mail Center Inbox 1 .

question_text: How do I know when customer service has responded to my message and how do I access new mail?
answer_text: When a Customer Service Team member replies to your Support Request, you will receive an email in your regular email inbox. The email will have a link that requires you to log in to access the message. 1 Note: If your email program does not show the link as clickable, you may need to copy and paste the link into the address field of your browser and press "Enter". When you log in to your account, there will also be a new message alert in Support Center if you have a new message in your Inbox. Log in to your account and click on the “Mail Center Inbox” link in the left navigation area to access Support Center.

question_text: What happens if I leave my computer or it takes me a long time to enter my support request?
answer_text: After 5 minutes of inactivity, you are automatically logged off the system and any information you entered is erased. This security feature is in place to protect your personal information. If you think it will take longer than 5 minutes to type your request, prepare it in advance, then copy and paste it into the Description field. 1

question_text: I updated my email address in My Profile, but Support Center still shows my old address. What should I do?
answer_text: To protect your privacy, your email address is not updated in Support Center until the next time you log in to your account. 1

question_text: Can I attach documents to a support request?
answer_text: Yes. After you submit a Support Request, the system will then display an attachment button below the message field, which you can use to attach your documents. 1

question_text: I got a message that my support request was resolved, but I still have questions. What should I do?
answer_text: If you have additional questions related to your resolved request, you can reply to a resolved Support Request. Please note that this will go directly to the Customer Service Team member who assisted you with the initial request. 1

question_text: Are all account questions handled in Support Center?
answer_text: Our Customer Service Team responds to Support Requests received through Support Center. If your account is being handled by a specific department, you may be directed to contact us by phone for assistance. 1

question_text: How long will it take to get a reply to my support request?
answer_text: On average, it can take 1-2 business days to receive a reply. For time-sensitive issues, please contact our Customer Service Team by phone. 1

question_text: What should I do if I am having technical difficulties?
answer_text: Please contact our Customer Service Team for help with any technical issues. 1

question_text: What is usage-based insurance?
answer_text: Usage-based insurance or UBI, is a way for you to opt-in to share your driving data and, based on how you and your family drive, potentially save money on an auto insurance policy. Visit https://toyotainsurance.com

question_text: What data is shared for usage-based insurance?
answer_text: With your consent, your modern car, truck, or SUV collects input from your vehicle every time you drive. Hundreds of sensors in the vehicle monitor data points including speed, braking, acceleration, driving time, steering, safety system activation, and even when your vehicle needs its next maintenance. Modern vehicles are equipped with a device called a Data Communication Module (DCM) that transmits telematics data every single second. Anti-lock braking systems (ABS), traction control, adaptive cruise control, all need to collect feedback from dozens of vehicle systems so that you can use them when you drive. Visit https://toyotainsurance.com

question_text: Is a Toyota Vehicle Service Agreement (VSA) the same as a manufacturer's basic warranty? How do they compare to other extended service plans?
answer_text: No. Toyota VSAs are optional, Toyota-backed plans that offer high quality protection against unexpected mechanical breakdowns. The manufacturer's basic warranty is included with the vehicle, where applicable. Some dealerships offer extended service plans that are honored only by the dealer, not backed by Toyota. A dealer-backed plan usually requires you to have your vehicle serviced at that specific dealership. Dealerships may also sell "aftermarket programs" backed by third-party companies that may further subcontract the work on your vehicle. Benefits of purchaing a Toyota Vehicle Service Agreement include: Reliability A Vehicle Service Agreement (VSA) backed by Toyota is a promise that we will take care of your covered repair needs whenever unexpected problems arise, using factory-trained technicians. Comprehensive Coverage You may use this VSA at any participating Toyota dealership in the U.S.A. and Canada. We offer a wide range of coverage levels with various time and mileage options — up to 8 years and 125,000 miles. You select the coverage and options that best meet your needs. Visit the Vehicle Service Agreement section for a comprehensive listing of coverage and terms available. Deductible Options Toyota’s VSA offers two options: a $0 deductible under which all covered repairs continue to be performed without charge, or a $100 disappearing deductible that will be applied to each covered repair visit not performed at your selling dealership. 1 Cancellation Toyota’s VSA may be cancelled at any time. You are entitled to a full refund less a fifty-dollar ($50.00) processing fee for cancellations within the first 30 days (as permitted by law) on both new and used vehicle contracts — for whatever reason you decide to cancel — as long as no claims have been filed on your contract. In all other cases, the refund will be pro-rated based on the elapsed time or mileage from the date the coverage began (less a $50.00 processing fee). 1 Transferability A new vehicle VSA may also be transferred to the second retail purchaser only of the vehicle at no additional cost. A VSA cannot be transferred to a dealership, entity or individual in the business of selling vehicles. 1 1. These terms may vary by product agreement and/or by state. Contact your Toyota dealer for details.

question_text: What does my Toyota Vehicle Service Agreement (VSA) cover? Is mechanical breakdown protection included?
answer_text: Your Toyota VSA provides additional benefits, above and beyond the manufacturer's basic warranty. With a VSA, you have access to benefits such as 24/7 roadside assistance, towing to the nearest Toyota dealer, car rental, meal and lodging reimbursement and more. As part of your Toyota VSA, mechanical breakdown protection covers eligible repair costs due to mechanical breakdown of covered components after your vehicle's factory warranty expires. Restrictions apply, and some benefits are not available on used vehicle plans or in Hawaii. See your Toyota dealer for complete details.

question_text: Where and when can I purchase a Toyota Vehicle Service Agreement? Can I purchase a VSA after I purchase my Toyota?
answer_text: You can purchase your Toyota Vehicle Service Agreement (VSA) at participating Toyota dealerships. Find a Dealer near you . Eligibility for a Toyota VSA is as follows: "New Vehicle" Vehicle Service Agreements are available for purchase during the first 3 years or 36,000 miles from time of purchase or lease, whichever comes first “Certified Used Vehicle” Vehicle Service Agreements are available for purchase during the first 12 months or 12,000 miles from time of purchase or lease, whichever comes first "Used Vehicle" Vehicle Service Agreements must be purchased at the time of used vehicle sale only

question_text: Can I buy a Toyota Certified Used Vehicle Service Agreement for my used vehicle?
answer_text: Yes. If your vehicle is a Toyota Certified Used Vehicle and has a Toyota Certified Used Vehicle Limited Powertrain, it is eligible for the Toyota Certified Used Vehicle Service Agreement. If you'd like a Vehicle Service Agreement for your used vehicle, take a look at our Used Vehicle Protection Plans .

question_text: What are my obligations with a Vehicle Service Agreement (VSA)?
answer_text: You'll need to perform all recommended maintenance procedures outlined in your vehicle's Scheduled Maintenance Log (specific to the year and model of your vehicle), including oil and filter changes, lubrication of key chassis parts, maintenance of proper fluid levels, replacement of belts, etc. Be sure to keep careful maintenance records. We recommend that you schedule your service appointments at your local Toyota dealer, where factory-trained, certified technicians use genuine Toyota parts. See your Toyota Vehicle Service Agreement for complete terms and conditions.

question_text: What are Voluntary Protection Products?
answer_text: Voluntary Protection Products are optional vehicle protection plans designed to help protect your investment and provide peace of mind against unexpected issues. Vehicle Service Agreements, Prepaid Maintenance, Guaranteed Auto Protection, Tire & Wheel Protection, Key Replacement, and Excess Wear & Use Protection are examples of Voluntary Protection Products. A Voluntary Protection Product is a product or service offered to vehicle buyers that is sold above and beyond the vehicle price. The purchase of a Voluntary Protection Product is optional, cancelable (subject to specific agreement terms) and not required to obtain credit.

question_text: What’s considered excessive wear and use?
answer_text: Any damage that is beyond normal wear and tear is considered excessive. Some examples might include tears or burns on upholstery, missing or broken equipment or large dents or scratches on the exterior of the vehicle. If it helps to see some examples of what’s considered excessive, check out our Wear and Use Guidelines . We also recommend reviewing your lease agreement as it includes additional excess wear and use information specific to your vehicle. Just a heads up, though, the examples provided may not include all instances of excessive damage that could subject you to additional charges based on the terms of your lease agreement.

question_text: Can I make repairs to my leased vehicle so I don’t incur wear and use charges?
answer_text: Of course. In fact, we encourage you to schedule a complimentary inspection and to review the Wear and Use Guidelines to see whether your vehicle has wear and use that is considered excessive. If repair work is needed and you'd like to make repairs prior to turning in the vehicle, your local Toyota dealer is a great option to assist you. Be sure to keep all of your receipts for repairs made and review your insurance policy to see if any items may be covered. If your damages exceeding normal wear and use aren't repaired, it can result in charges at lease termination. 1 All charges may be subject to sales tax.

question_text: What is a courtesy pre-inspection?
answer_text: A courtesy pre-inspection by your Lexus dealer assesses the condition of your vehicle and provides an estimate of wear and use charges that could be due at lease-end. 1 1 Courtesy pre-inspection available to lease customers who do not reside in Hawaii and whose leases did not originate in New Hampshire or Wisconsin.

question_text: How do I schedule a courtesy pre-inspection?
answer_text: You can contact your originating dealer or any Lexus dealer to determine if they can conduct a courtesy pre-inspection and appointment. We recommend completing this within 60 days before your vehicle return .1 1 Courtesy pre-inspection available to lease customers who do not reside in Hawaii and whose leases did not originate in New Hampshire or Wisconsin.

question_text: What do I need for my courtesy pre-inspection and lease return appointments?
answer_text: Bring the following to your pre-inspection and lease return appointments 1 : Vehicle keys Toolkit and spare tire Owner’s Manual Original equipment 1 Courtesy pre-inspection available to lease customers who do not reside in Hawaii and whose leases did not originate in New Hampshire or Wisconsin.

question_text: What should I do after my courtesy pre-inspection?
answer_text: After your courtesy pre-inspection, you can discuss the inspection report immediately with the dealer in person. You can access the report via the Document Center on our mobile app or at toyotafinancial.com. You can make repairs before turning in your vehicle - just be sure to keep receipts for your records.

question_text: What is this email and why did I receive it?
answer_text: An email that was sent to you includes encryption to ensure any sensitive information is shared securely. The email will direct you to a web portal to create an account and then view the content. It will also allow you to communicate securely with TFS.

question_text: How do I read the message sent to me?
answer_text: Click the link in the message body to launch a browser to authenticate so that you can decrypt and read the message.

question_text: Is this related to my online financial customer account?
answer_text: No, this is a separate account specific to an encrypted email. Do not try to login with your customer account credentials.

question_text: How do I login?
answer_text: If you have not registered for Email Encryption, you will be prompted to create an account and choose a password on the Registration page. Click Continue when you are done. In the future, you will not be prompted to register. If you have already registered, or if your account already exits, you will be prompted to sign in and provide your password to decrypt the message. Click Continue.

question_text: How do I reset my secure portal password?
answer_text: Click 'Forgot Password' link and an email will be sent to reset the associated password.

question_text: Expecting an encrypted email but haven’t received it?
answer_text: Some email anti-spam filters may block encrypted attachments or file them in your Junk mail. You may need to amend the settings in your email filter to permit such emails.

question_text: Having trouble opening the SecureMessageAtt.html file on a smart phone?
answer_text: Some smart phones do not allow posting content by opening the SecureMessageAtt.html file. If you cannot open the attachment to read the encrypted message, please use the link in the email notification to open the encrypted message instead.

question_text: Clicking on the link in the body of the email results in an error message: ‘the message you requested is not yet or no longer available’
answer_text: Try clicking the link once again after a few minutes.

question_text: Your account has been disabled or other login issues
answer_text: Please contact TFS_Email_Encryption_Team@toyota.com and let them know the specific issue you are seeing.
